_comment: 被动技能配置路径：data/<namespace>/kingdom_come_combat/passive_skills/*.json。每个技能可配置 name/display_name/title、description/desc/text、icon/texture、source(book、advancement、experience)、advancement/achievement、experience_cost/xp_cost/cost。source=book 需要在 data/<namespace>/kingdom_come_combat/skill_books/<id>.json 创建 passive_id 对应的技能书；source=advancement 会在玩家完成对应 advancement 后自动学习；source=experience 会出现在技能界面的可学习 tab，长按后消耗 experience_cost 经验点数学习，不是等级。icon 可写完整资源路径，也可只写文件名，对应 textures/gui/passive_skills/<icon>.png。

master_counter.name: 大师之击
master_counter.description: 大师之击包含了剑术大师记录的4种化被动为主动的攻击，交击，怒击，顶击，曲击。当敌人进攻时以相同方向的攻击触发，命中敌人。

en_us.name: Master Strike
en_us.description: Master Strike turns defense into an immediate attack through four counters recorded by swordmasters. Match the direction of an incoming attack to strike the enemy during their assault.

steady_guard.name: 稳固防守
steady_guard.description: 1次致命的打击比100次无用的打击更有效，所以静观其变。5秒不进攻会令体力恢复速度加快20%，持续到下次进攻开始

en_us.name: Steady Guard
en_us.description: One decisive blow is worth more than a hundred wasted strikes. Watch and wait. After 5 seconds without attacking, stamina regeneration increases by 20% until your next attack.

hunter.name: 怪物猎人
hunter.description: 沉着冷静地应对敌人。击杀敌人会令你恢复15点体力。

en_us.name: Monster Hunter
en_us.description: Face your foes with calm resolve. Killing an enemy restores 15 stamina.

fighter.name: 角斗士
fighter.description: 从古罗马起放弃盾牌的打法，代表着纯粹的血腥。如果只使用了一只手，造成额外的10%伤害

en_us.name: Gladiator
en_us.description: A shieldless style from ancient arenas, pure and bloody. If your offhand is empty, deal 10% more damage.

strong_arm.name: 贝奥武夫之臂
strong_arm.description: 力大无穷，你可以单手举起长剑，把它当成短剑使用。仅在副手持有物品时触发。以这种方式使用长剑时，伤害和攻击速度降低20%，攻击体力消耗增加20%。

en_us.name: Beowulf's Arm
en_us.description: Your immense strength lets you wield a longsword like a short sword while your offhand is occupied. Doing so reduces its damage and attack speed by 20% and increases attack stamina cost by 20%.

combo_attack.name: 势不可挡
combo_attack.description: 你的攻击速度极快，敌人难以反应，直到一击毙命。使用短剑快速连续攻击时，每次命中都会令后续攻击额外造成5%伤害；只要攻击间隔没有中断，增幅就会持续叠加。

en_us.name: Unstoppable
en_us.description: Your attacks come too quickly for the enemy to react. Each rapid successive hit with a short sword adds 5% damage to subsequent attacks, stacking until the attack rhythm is broken.

sword_master.name: 剑术大师
sword_master.description: 长剑作为最经典的武器有着最多的招式，千变万化，大师们研究了无数种架势和招式。当你使用长剑成功释放连招时，回复20点体力

en_us.name: Swordmaster
en_us.description: Longswords offer a vast repertoire of guards and techniques. Successfully landing a longsword combo restores 20 stamina.

brutal_strike.name: 致残打击
brutal_strike.description: 残暴的劈砍带来的巨大伤口会深深的陷入所有人，当你使用斧头释放连招时，额外造成2层部位击伤

en_us.name: Crippling Strike
en_us.description: Brutal axe blows leave grievous wounds. Landing an axe combo inflicts 2 additional levels of injury on the struck body part.

knight.name: 骑士精神
knight.description: 代表着骑士精神的阶级早已消亡，但是战马，纹章与骑枪依旧存在。骑士从不畏惧强敌。你在马匹上额外造成10%的伤害，额外减少15%的体力消耗

en_us.name: Chivalry
en_us.description: The knightly order may be gone, but warhorses, heraldry, and lances remain. While mounted, deal 10% additional damage and spend 15% less stamina.

darksoul.name: 黑暗之魂
darksoul.description: 如果你体力足够好，就可以穿着板甲却还灵动自如，你甚至觉得自己能在地上打个滚。降低盔甲的负面效果20%

en_us.name: Dark Soul
en_us.description: With sufficient endurance, even plate armor cannot stop you from moving freely. Armor penalties are reduced by 20%.

headshot.name: 箭矢穿颅
headshot.description: 你轻而易举的就射中了敌人的头部，享受着箭矢穿透的声音。如果你的箭矢命中了头部，造成额外20%的伤害。

en_us.name: Skullpiercer
en_us.description: You place arrows through the enemy's head with ease. Projectiles that strike the head deal 20% additional damage.

crossbow.name: 稳固射击
crossbow.description: 屏息然后握紧弩机，不要手抖，冷静瞄准。你射出的弩箭扩散减少50%，速度+10%。

en_us.name: Steady Shot
en_us.description: Hold your breath, steady the stock, and take careful aim. Crossbow projectile spread is reduced by 50% and projectile speed is increased by 10%.

duel.name: 决斗者
duel.description: 决斗不是一项高雅的运动，做好了拼死一搏的准备时，人会爆发出惊人的力量。如果你不穿着重甲（护甲值低于8点），额外获得20%的体力恢复速度，减少15%的闪避体力消耗，造成15%的额外伤害，释放大师之击时回复25体力。

en_us.name: Duelist
en_us.description: When your armor value is below 8, gain 20% stamina regeneration, spend 15% less stamina when dodging, deal 15% additional damage, and restore 25 stamina after a Master Strike.

death.name: 亡者之怒
death.description: 你的气息或许已经紊乱，奄奄一息，难以招架。可此时复仇的亡魂仍在燃烧。如果血量低于25%，造成额外的35%伤害，获得3层止痛效果，持续到血量高于25%

en_us.name: Wrath of the Dead
en_us.description: While below 25% health, deal 35% additional damage and gain 3 levels of Analgesia until your health rises above 25%.

dodge_buff.name: 灵巧步伐
dodge_buff.description: 战斗就像一支令人沉醉的舞蹈，轻巧的步伐让你能轻松的闪避敌人的攻击，你闪避消耗的体力降低40%

en_us.name: Nimble Footwork
en_us.description: Combat becomes a graceful dance beneath your practiced steps. Dodging costs 40% less stamina.

slash.name: 切割者
slash.description: 剑不要求一击毙命，但是你可以通过切割肌肉来消减敌人，你的连招会令敌人的体力恢复速度降低10%，持续2分钟，最多叠加3层

en_us.name: Sinew Cutter
en_us.description: Your combos cut muscle and reduce the target's stamina regeneration by 10% for 2 minutes. This effect stacks up to 3 times.

stable.name: 久经沙场
stable.description: 你的战斗技能已经炉火纯青，自然也能更快的从力竭中恢复过来，增加你的耐力恢复速度10%

en_us.name: Battle-Hardened
en_us.description: Long experience has taught you to recover quickly from exhaustion. Stamina regeneration is increased by 10%.

bloody.name: 热血沸腾
bloody.description: 当你击倒敌人时，你感觉到了前所未有的力量，当你击杀敌人时，在接下来的30s内获得体力恢复速度+20%

en_us.name: Blood Rush
en_us.description: Killing an enemy fills you with newfound strength, increasing stamina regeneration by 20% for 30 seconds.

blood_stop.name: 浓稠之血
blood_stop.description: 你的血液浓稠，让你得以更好的生存，流血dot的伤害间隔翻倍

en_us.name: Thick Blood
en_us.description: Your unusually thick blood helps keep you alive. The interval between bleeding damage ticks is doubled.

fighting_skill.name: 沙场老兵
fighting_skill.description: 当你战斗时，你感觉自己甚至忘记了伤痛，攻击命中敌人时为自己提供持续30s的止痛2效果

en_us.name: Veteran Warrior
en_us.description: In battle, you can forget even the deepest pain. Hitting an enemy grants 2 levels of Analgesia for 30 seconds.

fortress.name: 固若金汤
fortress.description: 穿戴重甲时，累计承受15点伤害会获得5秒固守；固守期间若护甲完全抵挡伤害，则免疫该次冲击效果。

en_us.name: Fortress
en_us.description: While wearing heavy armor, taking a total of 15 damage grants Fortified for 5 seconds. While Fortified, if your armor completely blocks the damage, you are immune to that hit's impact effect.

grand_finale.name: 好戏开演
grand_finale.description: 连招体力消耗增加10%，但造成15%的额外伤害。

en_us.name: Grand Finale
en_us.description: Combos cost 10% more stamina, but deal 15% additional damage.

focused.name: 全神贯注
focused.description: 生命值高于90%时，体力上限增加40点。

en_us.name: Focused
en_us.description: While your health is above 90%, your maximum stamina is increased by 40.

relentless_edge.name: 锋不可当
relentless_edge.description: 敌人非完美格挡你的攻击后，完美格挡概率降低5%，持续5秒，不可叠加。

en_us.name: Relentless Edge
en_us.description: After an enemy blocks your attack without performing a perfect block, their perfect block chance is reduced by 5% for 5 seconds. This effect does not stack.

opening_strike.name: 破绽打击
opening_strike.description: 攻击处于攻击动画中的敌人时，额外造成20%的冲击力。

en_us.name: Opening Strike
en_us.description: Attacking an enemy during their attack animation deals 20% more impact.

flywheel.name: 飞轮效应
flywheel.description: 发动连招后，20秒内体力消耗降低25%。

en_us.name: Flywheel Effect
en_us.description: After performing a combo, stamina costs are reduced by 25% for 20 seconds.

second_intention.name: 第二意图
second_intention.description: 当大师之击反制对方的完美防御反击时，恢复35点体力。

en_us.name: Second Intention
en_us.description: When your Master Strike counters an opponent's perfect defensive counter, restore 35 stamina.

terrifying_warrior.name: 骇人战士
terrifying_warrior.description: 你的战吼令人胆寒。施放战吼时，使10米内敌人的体力恢复速度降低20%，持续20秒；该效果有30秒冷却。

en_us.name: Terrifying Warrior
en_us.description: Your war cry strikes fear into nearby foes, reducing the stamina regeneration of enemies within 10 meters by 20% for 20 seconds. This effect has a 30-second cooldown.

rout_breaker.name: 溃逃破军
rout_breaker.description: 处决敌人会震慑其同伴，使附近敌人造成的伤害降低10%，持续30秒；该效果有60秒冷却。

en_us.name: Rout Breaker
en_us.description: Executing an enemy shatters the resolve of nearby foes, reducing their damage by 10% for 30 seconds. This effect has a 60-second cooldown.

hunter_plus.name: 资深猎人
hunter_plus.description: 你已经猎杀了无数生物，你对他们了如指掌，再也不会畏惧，击杀敌人会令你回复15点体力值，可以和怪物猎人叠加

en_us.name: Veteran Hunter
en_us.description: You have hunted every kind of monster and no longer fear them. Killing an enemy restores 15 stamina, stacking with Monster Hunter.
